text: 7月28日，市场监管总局在北京召开深入贯彻落实公平竞争审查制度专项行动推进会，听取有关地方工作进展情况，总结阶段性工作成效，部署推动下一阶段重点工作任务。总局党组成员、副局长孟扬出席会议并讲话。 专项行动围绕加快构建全国统一大市场，坚持问题导向，聚焦基层开展公平竞争审查存在的问题，针对性部署15项具体任务，指导各地结合实际扎实推进，取得阶段性工作成效，为公平竞争审查落地见效提供了有力保障。
text_en: On July 28, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a promotion meeting in Beijing on the special campaign to thoroughly implement the fair competition review system, hearing progress reports from relevant localities, summarizing phased results, and deploying key tasks for the next stage. Deputy Director of the Party Group and Administrator Meng Yang attended and delivered a speech. The campaign, focused on accelerating the construction of a unified national market, adopted a problem-oriented approach, targeted issues in grassroots fair competition review, and deployed 15 specific tasks, guiding localities to implement practical measures and achieving phased results that provide strong support for the effective implementation of fair competition review.
